events.description: Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay would be omnipotent for a day in a hypothetical scenario.
Phoebe Buffay says that if Phoebe Buffay were omnipotent for a day, Phoebe Buffay would want world peace.
Phoebe Buffay says that if Phoebe Buffay were omnipotent for a day, Phoebe Buffay would want there to be no more hunger.
Phoebe Buffay says that if Phoebe Buffay were omnipotent for a day, Phoebe Buffay would want good things to happen for the rain-forest.
Phoebe Buffay says that if Phoebe Buffay were omnipotent for a day, Phoebe Buffay would want Phoebe Buffay to have bigger boobs.
Ross Geller says Phoebe Buffay took Ross Geller's intended answer about what Ross Geller would do if Ross Geller were omnipotent for a day.
Chandler Bing says that if Chandler Bing were omnipotent for a day, Chandler Bing would be omnipotent for a day.
Chandler Bing says that if Chandler Bing were omnipotent for a day, Chandler Bing would make Chandler Bing omnipotent forever.
Rachel Green says there is always one generic person who, when given a wish, would wish for more wishes.
Rachel Green says that if Rachel Green had a wish, Rachel Green would have a wish.
Rachel Green says that if Rachel Green had a wish, Rachel Green would wish for three more wishes.
Monica Geller asks what Joey Tribbiani would do if Joey Tribbiani were omnipotent.
Monica Geller describes the hypothetical scenario in which Joey Tribbiani would be omnipotent.
Joey Tribbiani says that if Joey Tribbiani were omnipotent, Joey Tribbiani would probably kill Joey Tribbiani.
Monica Geller asks Joey Tribbiani to excuse Monica Geller.
Joey Tribbiani says that 'Little Joey' (a nickname for Joey Tribbiani's penis) would be dead if Joey Tribbiani were impotent.
Joey Tribbiani says that if 'Little Joey' were dead, then Joey Tribbiani would have no reason to live.
Joey Tribbiani asks whether Ross Geller is impotent.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is sorry to Ross Geller.
